verdict.rationale: TWC's own register-tax and unemployment-tax pages are written in plain, non-legal language for employers, for example explaining that registration can be saved and resumed and that a tax account number is issued immediately. It also publishes monthly employer hints. However, the evidence shows only fragments, not a complete step-by-step walkthrough. Missing for 10: an evidenced ordered step-by-step guide for a founder's task, coverage beyond unemployment-tax registration and filing, and independent or hands-on corroboration that a non-lawyer can follow it.

support.subject: As a founder, the service publishes plain-language, step-by-step guidance for my task — explainers a non-lawyer can follow, not just statute text and form numbers

citations.quote: If you cannot finish your registration, you can easily access it on UTR for up to one year. This way, you can come back later and continue where you left off.
UTR will allow you to immediately file any reports or pay taxes that are due. But you must do it as part of the registration process.
Learn how to update your business address, contact information, and close or reopen your tax account here.
Each month, the Tax Department provides useful hints, shortcuts, or helpful information to employers about Unemployment Tax and Unemployment Tax internet applications.
